about: SIN, COS, TAN, COT, CSC and SEC reproduce every double Excel was observed to return for them (ADR-0047): an angle reduced by pi rounded to the x87's 64-bit significand (FLDPI), as the seventeenth Windows run observed, SIN, COS and TAN the doubles nearest the exact values of the reduced angle and COT, CSC and SEC 1 over them, divided as doubles; the known answers are spikes/exsheet-trig-reduction/compare.py's --known table. Transcribed from ExSheet.Engine.Tests' TrigonometryReductionTests.
